baseline: Use the versioned E2 tagged-stem census at its recorded dates; no public news/tower substitutes
inputs: Publish IDs, SHA256, schema/status crosswalk, measurement units, sampled coverage, DBH/POM comparability, association audit and provenance ledger
reconstruction: Same 256-draw MNAR/wet-proxy architecture and fixed prior grids; if E2 supports a verified wet mask, register a separate amendment before examining E3
fit: Primary E0→E1 model stays frozen. Any E1→E2 refit is a separately archived prospective v2 issuance, never retroactively substituted into HFD02S
scenarios: D0,D1,D2,D3 config/design.json with explicit synthetic forcing; observed future environmental scenarios are a separate protocol
carrier_continuation: R1/C1 all alpha,beta,tau grids in config/design.json; no selection after outcomes
capacity_queries: Q1 and Q2 with all theta/rho grids; unconditional failure and unlawful mass retained
archive: Before E3: immutable public input/design/code/seed/manifest hashes; all posterior draws and unconditional weighted histories; issuance time and exposure inventory
outcome_operator: After E3: use stable stem IDs, actual dates, matching spatial support and measurement-error likelihood. Missingness never equals death; score only observed quantities and explicitly labeled latent estimates
scores: DBH/growth and alive-status predictive log score on interpretable paired records
basal-area/juvenile-support interval coverage and absolute error on comparable observed support
entry/death count consistency with sampling, status and elapsed-time alignment
Brier score only for predeclared observable endpoints, not unobservable full capacity Health
health_limit: A realized E3 trajectory cannot by itself validate the entire counterfactual capacity law or ontological forest Health
amendments: Register reason, code/config hashes, timestamp, prior exposure and new issuance identity before unobserved E3 outcomes; preserve all old outputs and report all semantic-grid results
prohibited: operational Health authorization from this specification
